newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech YSE 1996 net loss CZK 1.37 bln.
newsitem.headline: Czech YSE 1996 net loss CZK 1.37 bln.

text.p: Czech financial holding group YSE YSEPi.Pr said on Thursday it recorded an audited net loss in 1996 of 1.368 billion crowns, after a 51 million net profit in 1995.
YSE did not immediately comment on the figures, which it released in a statement.
Audited results for year ending December 31, 1996: (in

Note: YSE shares are traded on the main market of the Prague Stock Exchange. The company used to be an investment fund which turned into a financial holding firm last year before legislation requiring large disclosure at funds took effect.
It was accepted back to the bourse's main market after it agreed to continue in disclosure as an investment fund.

The firm did not give details on why it posted the loss, but several Czech funds have posted similar results following accounting moves adjusting the value of their portfolios from the nominal value of securities held to market value.
